subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the appropriate antonym for the underlined word.**

We will brush out the **__damp__** hair.
solution: The correct answer is** "droughty."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given word is **"damp"**, which means slightly wet or moist. (सीलनभरा) • **Example**:* The house had been empty and felt rather **damp**__.* • The antonym of **"damp"** is **"drought."** • **"Drought" **means having little or no moisture; dry or arid. (बहुत कम या बिल्कुल नमी न होना; सूखा या शुष्क) __ • **Example**: *I felt it was a **droughty**__ summer.* • The correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Saturated: **completely wet. (तर-बतर, सराबोर) • **Sticky: **used for describing a substance that easily becomes joined to things that it touches, or something that is covered with this kind of substance. (सहज चिपकने वाली या चिपकौआ वस्‍तु; चिपचिपी वस्‍तु) • **Moist: **slightly wet; damp. (हलका गीला; नम, आर्द्र) 18e:Tc77, The correct answer is **"large."**
